course.description: Unit 3 Places we live in--Lesson A-【例句】

sentences.content: Yes, they are. There is a playground. We often play there.
sentences.english: Yes , they are . There is a playground . We often play there
sentences.chinese: 是的，他们确实很友善。那里有一个游乐场，我们经常在那儿玩耍。

sentences.content: That's nice. There is also a nice park over there.
sentences.english: That's nice . There is also a nice park over there
sentences.chinese: 真不错。那边还有个很棒的公园。

sentences.content: We're at the park. Look! There is a shop. Great! Let's go and see.
sentences.english: We're at the park . Look ! There is a shop . Great ! Let's go and see
sentences.chinese: 我们在公园里。看！那里有家商店。太好了！我们去看看吧。

sentences.content: It's a place for us all!
sentences.english: It's a place for us all !
sentences.chinese: 这是属于我们所有人的地方！

sentences.content: Some ducks are in the park.
sentences.english: Some ducks are in the park

sentences.content: The poor ducklings feel cold there.
sentences.english: The poor ducklings feel cold there
sentences.chinese: 可怜的小鸭子们在那里感到寒冷。

sentences.content: Some nice children go back home, For black socks they can wear.
sentences.english: Some nice children go back home , For black socks they can wear
sentences.chinese: 几个乖孩子回到家，黑袜子可以穿啦。
